title: Non-Degenerate Construction and the Kernel of Admissibility
description: Establishes the basic requirements for a determinate construction: its identity, legitimate use, and continuation must remain consistent. Those requirements come before a ruler, a clock, or a physical equation.
scope: Fixed-domain, identity-preserving non-degenerate construction; not an unrestricted claim about arbitrary symbol systems.

title: Unus Solus Possibilis Est
description: Shows why the same fixed domain cannot have two competing admissible interiors. This supplies the common foundation that the gravity and quantum descriptions must share.
scope: Uniqueness in the standing-instantiated fixed-domain application; not a selection of every physical state or numerical parameter.

title: Gravity as Structural Necessity
description: Identifies gravity's prior role: the constraints that let physical states, comparisons, and changes belong to a coherent physical world. Spacetime curvature is a later description of that role.
scope: The regular AER physical comparison class; a structural gravity-role theorem, not yet an Einstein-equation derivation.

title: Einstein Dynamics as the Unique Minimal First-Response Metric Projection of AASC Gravity
description: Once a four-dimensional spacetime description is established, exhausts its minimal first-curvature responses. Consistent source accounting fixes the Einstein equation's form.
scope: Minimal local first-response Lorentzian metric scope. Numerical constants need calibration; richer gravitational responses are separately typed.

title: Schrodinger Dynamics as the Unique Minimal First-Response Hamiltonian Projection of AASC Quantum Standing
description: Takes the established quantum-state structure into a closed, scalar nonrelativistic spatial description. Its minimal Hamiltonian has the familiar kinetic-plus-potential Schrodinger form.
scope: Imports W9.19's generic standing construction; faithful spatial Hilbert representation, domains, and scale anchors remain separate burdens. It does not enlarge the rank-one WDW example or solve measurement.

title: Structural Unification of Gravity and Quantum Dynamics under AASC
description: Places the gravity and quantum descriptions on one underlying physical interior. Their interaction must preserve the same sources, records, and compatible continuation, not merely use similar-looking equations.

title: Connection-Typed Canonical Projection of the Frozen Einstein-Source Realization

scope: Proper spatial and certified internal redescription; not yet normal-constraint or quantum closure.

description: Shows when different ways of slicing the same spacetime history describe the same physics. The comparison must preserve sources, records, and boundary information.
scope: Classical constrained refoliation, occupied vacuum regular charts, and independently certified matter branches; singular and boundary cases remain distinguished.

description: Builds the mathematical setting in which the Wheeler-DeWitt constraint can actually act. Writing down a formal equation alone is not enough to establish physical quantum states.

scope: Pointed, recordwise Branch A with a rank-one physical quotient. The failed original candidates are not revived; broader state and observable claims are not implied.

description: Relates change to a physical matter-clock profile rather than an external master clock. In the constructed example the volume record changes, even though the physical quantum ray does not.

scope: Complete-certificate closure in the accepted module envelopes; weak equivalence remains separately conditional, and no all-regime or nonzero interacting quantum-gravity law is claimed.
